title: Ex-Google engineer: The one trait Larry Page, Sergey Brin and Sundar Pichai share
summary: A former Google employee observed a shared trait among leaders like Sundar Pichai, Larry Page, and Sergey Brin: a complete disregard for conventional thinking. Pichai's audacious decision to launch Google Chrome, despite widespread skepticism and even mockery, exemplifies this.
